components.what: raw waveform `source` (B×L samples), the forward input; unsqueezed to B×1×L inside the feature encoder; REPO applies no input normalization

7 Conv1d blocks, 512 channels (kernel/stride 10/5, then 3/2 ×4, then 2/2 ×2; total stride 320 samples), each Conv1d → Dropout(0) → GELU; in the default extractor_mode only the first block has a GroupNorm (512 groups); 'layer_norm' mode puts a LayerNorm in every block

encoder output transposed to B×T×512 and passed through Wav2Vec2Model.layer_norm (LayerNorm 512); cloned as unmasked_features, which feed the targets (after dropout_features), while `features` continue on the context path

Linear 512 → 768 (encoder_embed_dim) on the context path only, built because embed != encoder_embed_dim and quantize_input is off; followed by dropout_input; the quantizer side never passes through it

picks time-step spans with compute_mask_indices (mask_prob 0.65, mask_length 10, static, min_masks 2, same count per batch row) and overwrites them with the learned vector mask_emb (768-d, shared by all masked steps); returns mask_indices, which later select the targets and the context outputs used by the loss; channel masking exists but mask_channel_prob = 0 by default

TransformerEncoder: zeroes padded steps, adds the convolutional positional embedding to its input, LayerNorm (post-LN, layer_norm_first=False), dropout, then 12 Transformer layers; ConformerEncoder replaces it only when layer_type='conformer' with pos_enc_type rel_pos/rope
Conv1d 768→768, kernel 128, padding 64, 16 groups, weight-normalized, then SamePad (drops one trailing step) and GELU; a stack of conv+LayerNorm+GELU blocks replaces it only when pos_conv_depth > 1
residual add of the positional-convolution output to the encoder input x (the masked, projected features), followed by the encoder LayerNorm(768)

12 × TransformerSentenceEncoderLayer (768-d, 12 heads, FFN 3072, GELU; post-LN: self-attention → dropout → +residual → LayerNorm → fc1/GELU/fc2 → dropout → +residual → LayerNorm); standard internals, kept collapsed
encoder output x, B×T×768, one vector per time step; returned as is when features_only, otherwise reduced to the masked steps for the loss

built only if quantize_targets: per time step a Linear gives G×V = 2×320 logits, a hard Gumbel softmax picks one entry per group, and the chosen codebook vectors (384-d each) are concatenated to vq_dim 768; it is fed the unmasked, layer-normed 512-d features at the masked steps only
Linear 512 → groups·num_vars = 640 logits per time step (weights N(0,1), bias 0), viewed as (B·T'·G)×V
training: F.gumbel_softmax with hard=True (straight-through one-hot per group) at temperature curr_temp, annealed from 2 to 0.5 by ×0.999995 per update; eval: the plain argmax one-hot (hard_x)

learned parameter of shape 1 × (G·V = 640) × 384: G=2 codebooks of V=320 entries; the one-hot choice multiplies vars and sums within each group, and the G chosen entries are concatenated (view to B×T'×768)

Linear vq_dim 768 → final_dim 768 on the quantizer output (the linear transformation the draft places inside the quantization module; the code keeps it outside GumbelVectorQuantizer) and on codebook negatives; when quantize_targets is off it is Linear 512 → 768 on the unquantized unmasked features instead; removed for fine-tuning
targets y: one 768-d (final_dim) vector per masked time step, B×T'×768 (T' = masked steps per utterance); the positives and the pool distractors are drawn from

for every masked step draws num_negatives = 100 distractors uniformly (with replacement, under no_grad) from the other masked steps of the same utterance, skipping the step itself (neg_idxs >= tszs → +1); returns negs of shape 100×B×T'×768
Linear encoder_embed_dim 768 → final_dim 768 applied to the context output at the masked steps before the similarity; removed for fine-tuning

logits = cosine_similarity(projected c_t, [q_t; 100 distractors]) / logit_temp 0.1, shape 101×B×T'; distractors identical to q_t are set to -inf; get_targets labels index 0 (the true q_t) for every masked step; the cross-entropy over these logits is in a criterion outside REPO
penalty (G·V − prob_perplexity)/(G·V) with G·V = 640, where prob_perplexity = Σ over groups of exp(entropy of the softmax over V averaged across all quantized steps); its weight is set outside REPO
extra penalty: mean of the squared feature-encoder outputs (before the LayerNorm), returned by get_extra_losses next to the diversity term; its weight is set outside REPO; absent from the draft

data_flow.label: if not mask: features (C=768), unmasked (extract_features path)
x: masked features (C=768; masked steps = mask_emb)
x[mask_indices]: c_t at masked steps only (C=768)
mask_indices: keep only the masked time steps of c
mask_indices: only the masked time steps are quantized as targets
one-hot choice per group (straight-through); argmax at eval
if not quantize_targets: y = unmasked_features[mask_indices] (C=512), unquantized targets
negs: K=100 distractors per masked step (100×B×T'×768)
softmax of the logits averaged over steps (no Gumbel noise) → prob_perplexity

train_vs_infer.what: quantizer: training samples a hard Gumbel softmax at the annealed temperature curr_temp (set per update by set_num_updates); eval uses the deterministic argmax one-hot hard_x
LayerDrop: each Transformer layer is skipped with probability encoder_layerdrop only while training (default 0.0, so inactive by default)
dropout (p = dropout 0.1) after the positional-conv add and LayerNorm, and inside each layer, is active only in training
feature-extraction path: extract_features calls forward with mask=False and features_only=True, so no masking is applied and the encoder output is returned before the quantizer, negatives and logits
for fine-tuning, remove_pretraining_modules deletes quantizer, project_q, target_glu and final_proj (optionally truncating the Transformer layers)

unclear: REPO is only two files (fairseq/models/wav2vec/wav2vec2.py and fairseq/modules/gumbel_vector_quantizer.py) and is not a git repository, so commit is null. Wav2Vec2Model is the only top-level model (ConformerEncoder and the adapter layers are variants that are off by default).

The fine-tuning head (the draft's linear_proj into C classes) and the CTC loss (ctc_loss) are not in REPO; the only fine-tuning hooks present are remove_pretraining_modules and extract_features. Those two draft components have no code counterpart here and could not be checked.
The criterion is not in REPO: the cross-entropy that turns compute_preds' logits into L_m, and the weights of the diversity term (alpha) and of features_pen, cannot be read from this code.

quantize_targets defaults to False in Wav2Vec2Config, so with REPO defaults no quantizer is built and the targets are project_q(unmasked features) (continuous). The quantized path the paper describes needs quantize_targets=True, which would come from training configs that are not in REPO. Both paths are recorded with 'if quantize_targets:' / 'if not quantize_targets:' labels.

Feature-encoder normalization differs from the draft text: the default extractor_mode puts a single GroupNorm (512 groups) after the first conv only; the draft's 'temporal convolution followed by layer normalization' matches extractor_mode='layer_norm'. Which mode the paper's models used is not determined by REPO.

The draft's raw-audio normalization (zero mean, unit variance) is not in REPO (it belongs to data loading). The LayerNorm(512) on the encoder output (Wav2Vec2Model.layer_norm) is a separate, code-only step.

compute_mask_indices is not in REPO, so how mask_prob = 0.65 maps to span starts (the draft's 'proportion p of time steps as start indices') and how overlaps are handled cannot be verified here; only its arguments are visible.

The code resolves the draft's open question about the positional embedding: the conv output is added to the encoder input x, i.e. the masked, 768-d projected features (x = x + x_conv), then LayerNorm.

pos_conv, pos_add, enc_layers (in context_net) and q_weight_proj, gumbel_softmax, codebook (in quantizer) are one level inside blocks the draft marks 'reused'. The overview depth rule would collapse them unless the orchestrator marks context_net / quantizer as proposed; they are listed because the draft text describes these internals.

The draft's 'linear transformation R^d -> R^f' of the quantization module is Wav2Vec2Model.project_q, defined outside GumbelVectorQuantizer; it is kept as a top-level component because it also serves the unquantized-target path.

Off-by-default paths not drawn: input_quantizer/project_inp (quantize_input), target_glu, codebook_negatives, cross_sample_negatives, negatives_from_everywhere (quantizes all steps, then selects masked ones), channel masking (mask_channel_prob), GradMultiply / frozen feature extractor (feature_grad_mult != 1), padding-mask handling and crop_seq_to_multiple.

T (time steps) depends on the input length (stride 320 samples); T' (masked steps per utterance) depends on compute_mask_indices, made equal across the batch by require_same_masks=True. The audio sample rate is not in REPO, so the time span of one step is not stated.
